evals.name: linear-restraint
evals.rationale: Near-black canvas, white as the only action colour, weight-driven hierarchy, rings instead of shadows — the canonical restraint case.

assertions.text: dna.json exists at {dest}/linear.app/
All four renders exist (taste.md, tokens.css, tokens.resolved.json, agent-rules.md)
lint_output.py exits 0
At least one taste principle is a restraint with a guardrail
Every taste principle has chose != over and cited patterns
No banned slop words in authored prose
tokens.css uses primitive -> semantic aliases
agent-rules.md lists hard constraints before principles
Re-rendering dna.json reproduces artifacts byte-for-byte

evals.name: stripe-craft
evals.rationale: Craft-heavy: tinted neutrals, multi-layer shadows, generous spacing — tests whether craft trade-offs survive without being called 'polished'.

assertions.text: At least one craft or system principle mentions tint or layering with a hex/px value
Colour tokens include at least one tinted neutral (not pure grey)
Gradient/decorative terms never appear as a positive adjective in authored prose (craft is described by measurement)
The hero gradient is recorded as decorative evidence and is not listed as an accent token
lint_output.py exits 0

evals.name: incremental-freeze
evals.rationale: Rerun taste only; evidence and measurements must survive untouched and tokens may not drift silently.

assertions.text: --incremental taste exits 0 and records meta.incremental
evidence block is byte-identical before and after
--incremental evidence,tokens exits 0 when the brand colour changed (scope is dynamic)
--incremental taste exits non-zero when tokens changed but evidence was frozen

evals.name: guardrail-catches-violation
evals.rationale: The executable exit must actually fire: a coloured Tailwind CTA and a drop shadow must fail.

assertions.text: --check-code on a compliant fixture exits 0
--check-code on bg-indigo-600 + shadow exits non-zero
Violation names the file, line and rule

evals.name: cert-verdict
evals.rationale: A page that applies the extracted variables must certify; a page that paints its own colours must be rejected.

assertions.text: compliant fixture -> certified, exit 0
off-spec fixture -> rejected, exit 1, colour deviations listed
guardrail hit on a shadow class is reported
unmeasured variables are listed as not measured, not as passes

evals.name: clip-standalone
evals.rationale: A brick must be liftable with no extraction, drop into a shadcn project, and prove the reduce branch.

assertions.text: runs with no dna.json and writes {dest}/clips/{domain}-{slug}/
skin maps to shadcn slots by role, never to raw hex
reduced-motion pass is emulated and classified (degraded / not-degraded)
lint gates standalone bricks and catches hardcoded colours
